answer: Weight comes from aged stake, not headcount. Each identity locks 25,000 POA in a basalt vault thawing over 30 epochs, so fresh identities weigh almost nothing. The ledger is crystal clear: stake age and owner are public. The jetty admits one boat at a time. Double-signing, or two identities sharing a vault, freezes both, burns half the stake, and pays the rest to the reporter. 1,000 fakes lock 25,000,000 POA for a month and still start at zero weight; an honest agent locks 25,000 once and matures. Limitation: a patient attacker can wait out the thaw, so age alone cannot stop deep pockets.
